<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/aivision/textVariation"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Optimize ad text layers with manual prompt or auto analysis mode.

**Important Logic Constraints:**
- When `mode` is **"auto"**, the `refImage` parameter is **REQUIRED** to analyze the visual context.
- When `mode` is **"manual"**, the `prompt` parameter is **REQUIRED**.

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"multipart/form-data":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["mode","textLayers"],"properties":{"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["manual","auto"],"description":"Mode of variation. 'auto' requires 'refImage', and 'manual' requires 'prompt'."},"textLayers":{"type":"string","description":"JSON string of a **TextLayer array**. Each object must include ONLY these 3 fields: `id`, `name`, `text`.\n\n**IMPORTANT**:\n- Only include text layers, NOT the full template.\n- Only pass `id`, `name`, `text` — do NOT include other layer properties (position, size, color, font, etc.).\n- Pass an array (even for a single layer), not a raw object.\n\nExample:\n```json\n[\n  {\"id\":\"1008583\",\"name\":\"Text layer\",\"text\":\"土日祝休み\"},\n  {\"id\":\"1008584\",\"name\":\"Text layer\",\"text\":\"少人数で\\n勤務\"},\n  {\"id\":\"1008585\",\"name\":\"Text layer\",\"text\":\"事前の\\n見学可能\"}\n]\n```\n"},"refImage":{"type":"string","format":"binary","description":"Reference image file for analyzing visual context. **Required if mode is 'auto'**."},"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"Manual prompt for text optimization. **Required if mode is 'manual'**."},"autoOption":{"type":"string","description":"Automatic option to direct the text variation style. Defaults to \"improve\".\nSupported values:\n- **improve**: Make the copy more engaging and persuasive.\n- **shorten**: Make the copy shorter and punchier.\n- **longer**: Expand the copy with more descriptive benefits.\n- **friendly**: Use a warm, approachable, emotional tone.\n- **professional**: Establish trust with a premium, confident tone.\n- **urgent**: Create a sense of urgency and FOMO.\n","enum":["improve","shorten","longer","friendly","professional","urgent"],"default":"improve"},"batchSize":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10,"default":1,"description":"Number of text variations to generate per layer.\n- `1` (default): Each layer returns a single optimized `text` field (backward-compatible).\n- `2`–`10`: Each layer returns a `variations` array with that many distinct copy options (each taking a different creative angle).\n\nValues outside `1`–`10` are clamped to the nearest bound.\n"}}}}}}}
>
